task.title: Importing a schedule from a remote station
task.shortdesc: You would import a schedule from a remote device to a Supervisor station. Imported schedules and calendars are standard schedule components with a BacnetScheduleImportExt. Events in an imported schedule (or calendar) are obtained from that BACnet device, and are read-only. By default, the Schedules device extension also contains a Retry Trigger, for automatic usage as needed. For details refer to the .

taskbody.prereq: You are connected to the controller station that contains the schedule. The bacnet palette is open.

step.cmd: Drag a BacnetScheduleImportExt from the palette to a BacnetDeviceSchedules node in the Nav tree.

step.stepresult: The Bacnet Schedule Import Manager view opens automatically.

The system discovers all available schedules in the station.
The default import (read synchronization) from the device’s object is Manual, which means that to refresh the schedule, you must use the Import button in the Bacnet Schedule Import Manager view. Alternatively, if you anticipate ongoing changes to the object’s configuration, you can set the trigger time of the BacnetScheduleImportExt to be either Daily or Interval.

step.cmd: Select the schedule in the Discovered pane, do one of the following, and click OK.

choices.choice: Drag the selected schedule to the Database pane.

step.stepresult: The driver uploads the object configuration to the read-only schedule component.

taskbody.result: If an imported schedule contains a reference to a calendar object in the device, the driver imports the calendar object as well as the schedule. This keeps the schedule self-complete.
